official_identity: The current IHS Zuni Comprehensive Health Center page identifies the Zuni facility in Zuni, New Mexico and describes inpatient, outpatient and emergency services. CMS identifies the CCN as Zuni Comprehensive Community Health Center and Government - Federal.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership, facility-name agreement, and city/state/ZIP agreement with the current IHS page support the federal scope disposition. The IHS page uses a more detailed street variant (Route 301 North 21 B. Avenue); this is retained as an address variant, not treated as a mismatch. This is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
